decisions.reason: The source separately confirms that false NFTs no longer appear on the dashboard; the incorrect aggregate mint number does not change the dashboard ownership-listing requirement.
The incorrect public mint number does not change which referral, ticket, or prize data the dashboard reward summary must display.
The source concerns an aggregate mint-number display and does not alter the NFT metadata ticket counters.
The mint-number accuracy decision does not affect book-cover display or NFT detail-page presentation.
The source reports an inaccurate live statistic but does not direct any change to the About-page copy.
The aggregate mint-number correction does not change fiat buyers' wallet provisioning, dashboard access, or reward-access behavior.
Requiring the displayed mint count to reflect completed mints does not change the rule that an actual NFT's mint number is its permanent referral code.
The source does not state that certificate emails contain an incorrect mint number or change their required contents or read action.
The inaccurate aggregate count does not alter how an existing NFT's mint number, book, badges, or tickets behave on transfer.
The public mint-number accuracy issue is unrelated to landing-page book-cover size, placement, visibility, or control overlap.
The source does not revise the landing-page hero copy, mechanics preview, CTA, or layout.
The observed aggregate-statistics defect does not necessarily require any change to the approved FAQ content about valid NFT mint numbers and referral codes.
